expectedRealization.rationale: Contract liabilities/backlog and UHV/grid delivery should convert through H2 over one to two reporting cycles.

changeHypothesis.summary: Global power-equipment demand remained strong. 思源 had the best reported H1 growth, but 许继 offered the stronger frozen asymmetry: depressed H1 revenue/profit, sharply improved cash flow and contract liabilities, a cut/low expectation baseline, and materially lower forward valuation with H2 delivery catalysts.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: ABB and GE Vernova independently reported record/strong orders and growing backlog.
disconfirmingEvidence: 许继 H1 revenue fell 5.7% and profit was nearly flat.
配网 price competition can pressure margin.
If contract liabilities do not convert, the catch-up thesis fails.

causalChain.mechanism: Large grid/data-center projects sustain transformer/switchgear/UHV demand.
Rising contract liabilities and Q2 cash inflow indicate delivery backlog despite weak H1 revenue recognition.
A lower frozen forward PE and down-revised baseline require less upside surprise than stronger-growth peers.
causalChain.failureMode: weak H1 reflects structural competitiveness rather than timing

selectionComparison.rationale: v0.8 prefers the lower-expectation catch-up candidate rather than automatically selecting the best H1 growth company.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: 许继's 2025-27 profit estimates had just been cut, despite forecast full-year profit still +28%; PE about 17x versus 思源 24.6x and 伊戈尔 32x on their frozen references.
expectations.thesisExpectation: H2 delivery converts elevated contract liabilities and cash receipts into earnings catch-up.
expectations.measurableGap: The baseline is weak enough that ordinary backlog conversion can beat the frozen H1 narrative without requiring premium valuation.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Forward PE and H2 delivery/cash conversion versus matched power-equipment peers.
expectationBurdenTest.marketBaseline: 2025E profit RMB1.426bn after estimate cuts; reference PE ~17x.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: H2 UHV/grid delivery lifts full-year growth toward or above the already-cut baseline.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: Backlog/contract liabilities must convert without major margin deterioration; no multiple expansion is required.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: H1 weakness proves structural and backlog converts at low margin or slips into 2026.
expectationBurdenTest.catalystOrTimingBridge: H2 delivery and next quarterly report directly test contract-liability conversion within 20-60d.

fundamentalAcceleration.rationale: External order cycle is strong while company cash/contract-liability indicators improved.

realizedCompanyConfirmation.rationale: Cash flow and contract liabilities improved before revenue recognition caught up.

crossSectionalConfirmation.rationale: 许继 has lower valuation/headroom, while peers have stronger current growth but higher expectations.

baselineLag.rationale: The forecast was cut after weak H1, leaving a low bar relative to backlog/cash indicators.

priceAbsorption.checkMethod: Use frozen opportunity-basket regime and selected stock's underperformance within it.

fundamentalImpulse.rationale: Independent global suppliers report record/strong orders and backlog.

eventHalfLife.rationale: Grid/UHV backlog converts over multi-quarter project cycles.

opportunityTimingTest.rationale: Industry fundamentals and basket regime remain positive without universal crowding.

qualityFloor.rationale: Positive profit, very strong cash-flow improvement and contract liabilities clear the quality floor despite weak H1 revenue.

revisionHeadroom.rationale: A cut 2025 baseline plus H2 backlog/cash conversion creates more upward catch-up space than already-strong peers.

catalystReachability.rationale: H2 UHV/grid delivery and quarterly recognition can surface within the base horizon.

downsideContainment.rationale: Lower valuation and strong cash receipts reduce the burden if growth merely normalizes.
